screens_and_architecture.name: Merchant Onboarding
components: Business Name Input
Business Type Selector (Patio Restaurant, Food Truck, Outdoor Event, Boat Tour, Car Wash, Mini Golf)
City Dropdown (Chicago KORD, Miami KMIA, New York KNYC, Austin KAUS, Seattle KSEA)
Average Booking Value ($10 - $500)
Weekend Bookings Estimator

screens_and_architecture.name: Customer Checkout Widget

DatePicker with Weather Probability Indicator

Official Trigger Text Modal/Tooltip (rules_primary: 'Triggered by NWS station >0.10 in precip')

screens_and_architecture.name: Merchant Dashboard
components: Merchant Picker Header (Maria's Patio Taqueria Chicago, Bayfront Boat Tours Miami)
KPI Cards: Guarantees Sold, Refunds Promised, Contracts Held, Hedge Cost
'If it Rains vs If it Doesn't' Dual P&L Cards
Live City Rain Probability & Kalshi Order Book Depth Chart

screens_and_architecture.name: Settlement Replay Engine
components: Historical Date Selector
Animated Resolution Timeline (Market Resolves YES/NO -> Refunds Issued -> Kalshi Hedge Pays -> Net Merchant P&L)
Interactive Comparison (Rainy Saturday vs Sunny Saturday)

screens_and_architecture.name: Pitch Footer & Trust Center
components: CFTC-Regulated Exchange Disclosure
Official Station Weather Data Clarification
No-Basis-Risk Guarantee Explanation

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid on every interactive button, input, toggle, select, tab, and KPI card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a rich multi-screen SPA using React and React Router.
Provide seed merchants pre-loaded: Maria's Patio Taqueria (Chicago) and Bayfront Boat Tours (Miami).
Ensure all components are fully mobile responsive at 375px width.
Use Framer Motion for smooth tab switches and the Settlement Replay step-by-step animation.
Include sonner toast notifications for user interactions (e.g. hedge contract executed, checkout completed with rain protection, merchant profile saved).
Use Lucide icons extensively for weather and fintech visual cues (CloudRain, Sun, ShieldCheck, TrendingUp, DollarSign, Activity, CheckCircle, ArrowRight).
